text: The following information relates to the business of Nother Limited.
During the year ended 31 March 2014 a machine was sold for $14 000. This had been
debited to the bank account and credited to the sales account.
The machine had been purchased for $44 000 and depreciation of $24 000 had been written
off up to 31 March 2013. A full year’s depreciation is provided in the year of purchase but
none in the year of sale.
Depreciation is to be provided as follows:

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare Nother Limited’s manufacturing account for the year ended 31 March 2014.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Prepare Nother Limited’s income statement for the year ended 31 March 2014.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Explain the following terms.
Direct costs

Indirect costs

Prime cost

Production cost

2 Bill and Charles are in partnership sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 2:1.
Each partner draws $2000 cash from the business each month.
On 1 October 2013 Bill paid $24 000 into the business bank account.
They provided the following information.
Capital accounts 1 January 2013
Bill 120 000
Charles 60 000
Current accounts 1 January 2013 31 December 2013
$ $
Bill 17 000 Cr 2 160 Cr
Charles 18 000 Cr 2 800 Dr
REQUIRED

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Calculate the partnership profit for the year ended 31 December 2013 before
appropriation.

Additional information
On 1 January 2014 a new partnership agreement came into force which stated that Bill and
Charles will share profits and losses in the ratio of 3:2. Bill will receive $6000 salary per annum,
and Charles $5200 salary per annum.
The rate of interest on capital is to be 8% per annum and interest on drawings is to be charged at
11% per annum.
Bill and Charles will continue to withdraw $2000 each per month.
Goodwill was valued at $48000 but is not to be retained in the books of account.
The net profit for the 6 months ended 30 June 2014 was $12000.
REQUIRED

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Prepare the capital accounts of Bill and Charles for the six months ended 30 June 2014.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Prepare the partnership appropriation account for the six months ended 30 June 2014.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Prepare the current account of Bill for the 6 months ended 30 June 2014.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: State two reasons why the partners are charged interest on drawings.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
State two reasons why the partners receive interest on capital.
